title: Qualification matrix for runtime and access-point changes
summary: A Wire UI runtime change is not qualified by unit tests alone. Validate exact package integrity, server/browser protocol compatibility, Queue Fabric/gateway reliability, cold/warm definitions, stale actions, resources and constrained-network delivery as applicable.
minimum_matrix: server ooRexx suite for changed semantic contracts
gateway fixed-queue/ACK-NACK-release tests when transport changes
cold definition delivery and warm content-address cache suppression
definition barrier for authorised cold CREATE_INSTANCE
positive observation allow-list behaviour when observation contracts change
exact ResourceRef and content-address verification when resources change
source and optimised/GPRS launcher equivalence when static delivery changes
one real cross-language application journey through Queue Fabric for integration cuts
anti_claims: Do not call a MemoryRenderer microbenchmark a React comparison.
Do not claim Chromium/Firefox qualification when only a Node DOM-compatible harness ran.
Do not claim BSF4ooRexx qualification from Java-only Swing tests.
Do not claim a resource has been rendered when only its identity was transported.

provenance.claim: JS validation and benchmark scope explicitly exclude React comparison.
Gateway/browser security boundary that must be preserved during qualification.
